trap.label: phrasal iron out
trap.wrong: We iron out the problem of.
trap.why: O brasileiro tenta “resolver” literalmente e esquece o verbo. Em inglês, iron out = acertar/resolver detalhes.

fix.wrong: They iron out of the details.
Let’s iron the problem out of.

rewrite.prompt: Use iron out: “We resolved the details.”

rewrite.answer: We will iron out our differences.

rewrite.prompt: Use iron out: “Let’s settle the problem.”
